edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _owner during construction, making ownership caller-controlled.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the sender of tokens.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
manualswap authorization compares msg.sender against hardcoded dev/marketing addresses.
manualsend authorization compares msg.sender against hardcoded dev/marketing addresses.
msg.sender is passed as from into _transfer, affecting the trading gate and bot checks.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument of _approve.
owner() and onlyOwner compare _owner against msg.sender.
setTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which depends on msg.sender.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp becomes the deadline of the router swap, making execution miner-influenceable.
constructor queries owner() to set fee exclusions.
constructor mints the full reflection supply into _rOwned.
constructor stores the router address in uniswapV2Router.
constructor stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
constructor marks owner, contract, development and marketing as fee-excluded.

renounceOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
restoreAllFee restores _redisFee from the cached value.
restoreAllFee restores _taxFee from the cached value.
_transfer calls owner() to decide whether the trade gate applies.
_transfer calls balanceOf for contract and recipient balances.
_transfer reads and writes the bots blacklist.

_transfer sets _taxFee from the buy or sell configuration.
_transfer uses launchBlock for the sniper window check.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before swapping.

_transfer implements the trade gate and sniper blacklist logic.
The swap initiated from _transfer can return ETH to the contract, invoking receive.

The router swap sends ETH back to the contract, hitting the payable receive function.

sendETHToFee transfers half the balance to _marketingAddress.
sendETHToFee performs raw ETH payouts to external addresses.

manualsend relies on a msg.sender address equality check instead of owner authorization.
